# PR-XRay: Client-Side SAST Security Engine
> Autonomous static application security testing platform running 100% locally in browser memory via WebGPU and WebAssembly.

## Overview
- Developer: OnePersonAI Systems Lab (Akshat Raj)
- Canonical URL: https://pr-xray.onepersonai.in
- Core Features: Zero-data-ingestion AST taint analysis, Shannon entropy secret scanning, local neural patch synthesis.
- Performance: Single-threaded and SIMD Wasm fallback with direct WebGPU hardware acceleration.

## Use Cases
- SAST Code Auditing
- API Key and Secret Leak Prevention
- Pull Request Automated Review
